objeto: Paper B ITT v3 — registered analysis with six switches (washout out of the denominator; sessions attributed to the epoch of their start) vs implemented analysis

painel.regra: DEVIATIONS §10.31: deepseek only where the 3 families leave < 3 substantive verdicts

washout.regra: PREREG l.642/l.644/l.1036: units (epoch, session) starting inside the 2 h washout leave the session-hour denominator AND the outcomes; a_past corpus never cut

registrado.escopo: episodes of the analysis window 2026-09-01..2026-09-20 (09-02 included)

sessoes_atravessadas.regra: PREREG §2 item 3: boundary-straddling sessions belong to the epoch of their start (switch 6, registered 'with'); the registered sensitivity 'without' drops every session with episodes in more than one epoch

leitura_depositada.regra: PREREG l.1025: H1 primary, alone at alpha=0.05; H1a-c + H2 Holm within the secondary family

H2.definicao: PREREG §4.2 + task_regret.py: regret = max(0, x - min over successful (not is_error) episodes of the same sig_primary, >=5 of them); tokens = input+output+cache_creation; winsorized at the LOCKED p95 for the estimator, raw for the sharp-null test
escolhas_nao_fixadas_pelo_registo: baseline ('best known resolution') computed over the whole locked corpus (5,951 episodes, 2026-08-23..2026-09-21), both arms pooled, arm-blind
population = every post-washout action in the analysis epochs (not only opportunities)
effect = difference of per-arm means pooled over episodes (ratio of sums), same epoch bootstrap/BCa as H1; sharp-null statistic = per-epoch raw mean, trend-residualized
